dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: There's something going on, isn't there?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: So it isn't just me... Everyone has their bad days...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: But it's okay! That's just life — sometimes we get hurt, and sometimes we get to sing happy songs.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: A heartless sailor from foreign lands once broke my heart. But look at me now, I can still dance!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Ah, I forgot to mention that I am a street performer. Come see me dance if you're in a bad mood!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: That's great! I'm happy for you!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Bad luck is only temporary but good luck is forever! Waltz through whatever comes your way, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: H—How did... No. I have to rethink my deck composition.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Hehe, it seems that you need to be more careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can teach him a lesson for you.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: I appreciate your offer, but I'm afraid I'll have to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Not that I don't trust your abilities, I just want to do it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Once I save enough money from my performances, I'll hire the best Eremite mercenary to teach me the most powerful fighting skills.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Then I can take a ship to Liyue and smack that cheater hard on the face!
